verdict.rationale: Brex's API surface (Accounting, Budgets, Team, Webhooks) is for managing Brex's own corporate card/spend product programmatically, not for embedding banking-as-a-service or issuing licensed financial accounts to a developer's own customers. There is no evidence of BaaS/account-issuing APIs, and community evidence instead shows Brex rejecting/closing accounts and narrowing focus away from broad customer-facing banking, contradicting a banking-as-a-service offering.
